design_vision: A heavy-duty, modern industrial interface. Think fuel pumps, diesel amber, oil-black, steel greys, and hazard-yellow highlights. The UI must feel precise, reliable, and functional, avoiding standard 'SaaS' softness. No purple/violet, no Inter/Roboto. Use sharp edges, high contrast, and tactile feedback.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. Must use tracking-tight to tracking-tighter for a compact, bold industrial look.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and standard UI text.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all numbers, prices, fuel quantities, gauges, and statuses. This provides the 'dashboard instrument' feel.

background.description: Oil Black - deepest background for main app area.

surface.description: Steel Greys - used for cards, dialogs, and elevated sections.

primary.description: Hazard Yellow - used for primary CTAs (Book Fuel), active states, and critical highlights.

secondary.description: Diesel Amber - used for secondary actions, en route statuses, or warning labels.

border.description: Industrial grid lines and card separators.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense but structured. Use 'Control Room' grid rules for dashboards. Everything should align rigidly like a machine interface.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the grid. Use 1px solid borders (border-zinc-800) extensively to segment data instead of relying on shadows.

button.primary: bg-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none border border-yellow-400 transition-all
button.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 text-zinc-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-all

table.header: bg-[#1A1A1D] text-zinc-400 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest py-3 border-b border-zinc-800

dialog.content: bg-[#121214] border border-zinc-700 rounded-none shadow-2xl p-6

tabs.list: bg-transparent border-b border-zinc-800 rounded-none p-0 flex space-x-6
tabs.trigger: bg-transparent data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:border-b-2 data-[state=active]:border-yellow-400 data-[state=active]:text-yellow-400 text-zinc-500 rounded-none px-0 pb-3 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

badge.base: font-mono text-xs px-2 py-1 uppercase rounded-none border

input.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-700 rounded-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:border-yellow-400 text-white font-mono placeholder:text-zinc-600

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp border color changes, no soft shadows. Use slight translate-x for list items on hover.
motion_and_interactions.gauges: When filling fuel quantity, use a rising bar or counter animation for the numbers.
motion_and_interactions.status_pills: When status changes, use a quick blink or flash (like an LED indicator) before settling on the new color.

media_urls.description: Large silver fuel truck. Apply a heavy black/gradient overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text readability.
White and black storage truck on gray asphalt. Good for driver management pages.
Oil refinery at night. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for the login or landing page.
Dark asphalt texture. Can be used as a repeating background pattern at 5-10% opacity.

icons.style: Use 'regular' or 'bold' weight to match the thick industrial typography. Avoid thin or soft icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No purple, violet, or generic SaaS blue.
Do NOT use standard rounded corners for Shadcn components. Override them to rounded-none to maintain the brutalist industrial feel.
Implement the specified fonts (Barlow Condensed, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html or layout file.
Ensure the location picker (even if mocked) looks like a tactical radar or grid map rather than a soft consumer map.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and status badges.
For the booking form, use large, legible monospace typography for the fuel quantity and live price computation.
Apply 'tasteful grain/noise' via a subtle fixed background overlay (e.g., an SVG noise filter or the provided asphalt texture at very low opacity).
